milestone.describes: Level 1 of the built-in levels is being played: tapping a blue block removes it, the blocks above topple, a +10 popup and particles appear, and Score/Hi-Score rise.

steps.expect: The title menu with NEW GAME on it. The note allows about 10 s.
Level 1: the tower, with Level, Lives (15), Score and Hi-Score drawn around it and a close button.
The blue block vanishes, particles and a +10 popup appear, blocks above fall, Score 0 -> 10.
A second block removed, Score rises again.
A third block removed. Score has risen and Lives may have fallen — which blocks the taps land on decides the exact numbers, so read them as evidence the loop is running rather than as fixed values.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 768x1024 portrait iPad window.
`--force-composition` is part of the route, not a preference: the milestone was recorded with it. Check whether it is still needed before dropping it.
The three block coordinates were blue blocks when this was recorded. Blocks move as earlier ones are removed, so a later tap can land on empty space and do nothing; that is not a failure of the app.
